# Awesome JEV

> A free, community-curated directory of GitHub projects related to TypeSafe AI's Jev / System One models.

The website has a searchable directory, category pages, and one detail page per GitHub project at /projects/{owner}/{repo}. Project pages show curated summaries and link to the original third-party repositories. The Jev news section shows source-attributed summaries and links to the source, not full articles. Project metadata and the directory change over time.

## Directory

- [Browse Awesome JEV](https://awesomejev.cc/): Current project directory and Jev news.
- [GitHub project catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daftAI2026/awesome-jev/main/README.md): Markdown list of projects grouped by primary use.

## About the project

- [Contributing guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daftAI2026/awesome-jev/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Scope and submission guidelines.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/daftAI2026/awesome-jev): Source code and structured directory data.
